about_the_game:
Create your own saga with the Myth Hunter Gear pack! Includes the Dragon Scales outfit and the Serpent Lash bow. The Dragon Scales outfit features closely-guarded fabric treatments reducing fire damage, preventing stumbling, and increasing your health restoration. The Serpent Lash bow is a coveted weapon, granting you the ability to purge your enemies with fiery flames of the underworld.

Included in the Croft Edition, the Season Pass, and The Serpent's Heart. Also available separately.
